energy_augmented_mapping.energy_policy: Use structural objective energy as a progress potential so the explorer prefers changes that look goal-consistent, not merely non-zero.

frame_change_mapping.acceptance_gate: reduce median actions-to-first-levelup without reducing held-out solve-rate
frame_change_mapping.candidate_policy: Predict which action/click cells are feasible and likely to change the frame, then prune low-affordance no-op candidates before BFS expansion.
frame_change_mapping.training_signal: Use human replay and cached explorer transitions as action-effect labels: frame_delta, click cell, action_id, and object/contact region.

methods.name: What can I do here? A Theory of Affordances in Reinforcement Learning
methods.pitfall: availability is not progress; the mask must be paired with energy or level-progress checks before solve claims.
methods.stack_mapping: Treat affordances as a learned feasible-action mask that reduces the branching factor before transition/value scoring.

methods.name: Learning Affordance Landscapes for Interaction Exploration in 3D Environments
methods.pitfall: the source setting is RGB-D 3D exploration; ARC use must stay frame-only and cannot read hidden environment state.
methods.stack_mapping: Port the image-region-to-action-success idea into an ARC click heatmap plus ACTION1-5 frame-change head.

methods.name: Cross-Embodied Affordance Transfer through Learning Affordance Equivalences
methods.pitfall: robot trajectory transfer does not directly imply discrete ARC action transfer; it only motivates the representation.
methods.stack_mapping: Use object/action/effect triples as the representation target for cached ARC action-effect examples.

methods.name: Affordance-Guided Reinforcement Learning via Visual Prompting
methods.pitfall: a live VLM reward is not an ARC competition substrate; this artifact uses only the shaping pattern.
methods.stack_mapping: Take the dense affordance-shaped reward pattern, but replace VLM keypoint rewards with local structural energy progress.

methods.name: Learning Affordances from Interactive Exploration using an Object-level Map
methods.pitfall: object mapping must be deterministic from frames; no game internals or private state can enter the labels.
methods.stack_mapping: Track object instances across views so repeated ARC transitions produce denser action-effect labels instead of isolated pixels.

methods.name: PALM: Progress-Aware Policy Learning via Affordance Reasoning
methods.pitfall: PALM is a VLA manipulation stack; Carnot should borrow progress cues, not the model substrate.
methods.stack_mapping: Use progress-aware affordance reasoning to separate repeated frame-changing actions from actions that advance a subtask.

methods.name: Search Inspired Exploration in Reinforcement Learning
methods.pitfall: online RL frontier growth is not a banked ARC solve; use the idea as a pruning and ordering policy over cached candidates.
methods.stack_mapping: Select frontier state-action pairs by cost-to-come/cost-to-go and learning progress instead of flat repeated BFS expansion.

methods.name: SLOPE: Optimistic Potential Landscape Shaping for Model-based Reinforcement Learning
methods.pitfall: optimistic learned rewards can overstate progress; structural energy and solve-rate guards must stay authoritative.
methods.stack_mapping: Map optimistic potential landscapes onto Carnot's objective energy term so sparse level-progress can guide search earlier.

strongest_for_v417: flagged_for_v417: affordance-pruned frame-change predictor with SLOPE-style optimistic energy progress shaping, anchored by arXiv:2008.09241, arXiv:2006.15085, and arXiv:2602.03201
